title: JmapRequestBuilder mixes panic (build) and Result (add_call) error style
description: add_call returns Result<&mut Self, ClientError> for duplicate call_id. build() panics for empty method_calls. A caller who catches all add_call errors via ? and suppresses them (or uses an if-let that discards Err) will then call build() and get an opaque panic instead of a propagatable error. The inconsistency is a pattern that well-intentioned contributors will copy: future add_call-like methods will return Result, future build-like methods will panic, creating a permanently mixed API style that is hard to use in libraries that must not panic.
